clip_key: # Lonapse 0.6.0 lines (sr_). Written as drafts, converted to this table.

english: Clean liftoff! Everyone down here is cheering. | Clean liftoff! Everyone down here is cheering. | Clean liftoff! The room is cheering.
Tower cleared. Have a good trip. | Tower cleared. Have a good trip. | Tower clear. Good trip, {vessel}.
We're going! We're really going! | We're going! We're really going! | We're flying! Really flying!
Good thrust. This pushes a lot. | Good thrust. This pushes a lot. | Strong thrust. It really pushes.

spanish: Control, el cohete va hacia arriba. Como debe.
english: Control, the rocket is going up. As it should. | Control, the rocket is going up. As it should. | Control, we're going up. Like we should.

spanish: Confirmado. Esa es la dirección buena.
english: Confirmed. That's the right direction. | Confirmed. That's the right direction. | Confirmed. Up is correct.
Control, what a noise! | Control, what a noise! | Control, so loud!

spanish: Es el sonido del dinero. Seguid.
english: That's the sound of money. Carry on. | That's the sound of money. Carry on. | That's money you hear. Keep going.
All nominal. Enjoy the ride. | All nominal. Enjoy the ride. | Everything nominal. Enjoy it.
Climbing. All green. | Climbing. All green. | Going up. All green.
Good trajectory. Keep it up. | Good trajectory. Keep it up. | Nice trajectory. Keep going.

spanish: Altitud subiendo bien. Ni un susto.
english: Altitude rising nicely. Not a single scare. | Altitude rising nicely. Not a single scare. | Nice climb. No scares.
Clean ascent. The engineers are smiling. | Clean ascent. The engineers are smiling. | Clean climb. Engineering is smiling.

spanish: El cielo se pone oscuro. Qué bonito.
english: The sky is getting dark. How pretty. | The sky is getting dark. How pretty. | The sky goes dark. Beautiful.

spanish: Control, ya casi no hay aire fuera.
english: Control, there's almost no air outside now. | Control, there's almost no air outside now. | Control, barely any air out there.
Correct. Don't open the window. | Correct. Don't open the window. | Correct. Keep the window shut.
Pitching over as planned. | Pitching over as planned. | Pitching over, like the plan says.
We see it. Perfect. | We see it. Perfect. | Copy. Perfect.
Control, are we good on speed? | Control, are we good on speed? | Control, speed okay?
Very good. Don't overdo it. | Very good. Don't overdo it. | Very good. Don't push it.

spanish: Esto es como subir en un ascensor muy grande.
english: It's like riding a very big elevator. | It's like riding a very big elevator. | Like a giant elevator.

spanish: Seguid el perfil. Lo estáis bordando.
english: Follow the profile. You're nailing it. | Follow the profile. You're nailing it. | Stay on profile. You're doing great.
All stable. My stomach, less so. | All stable. My stomach, less so. | Stable. My stomach isn't.
Welcome back to the air. | Welcome back to the air. | Back in the air again.
Good angle. Hold it. | Good angle. Hold it. | Nice angle. Keep it.
We're starting to feel the air. | We're starting to feel the air. | The air is starting to push.
Control, it's starting to glow here. | Control, it's starting to glow here. | Control, things are glowing.
Normal. Shield forward. | Normal. Shield forward. | Normal. Keep the shield in front.
Control, how are we doing? | Control, how are we doing? | Control, how's it look?
Very well. You're coming home. | Very well. You're coming home. | Very good. You're on your way home.

spanish: Volvemos a casa. Con algo de calor.
english: Heading home. With a bit of heat. | Heading home. With a bit of heat. | Going home. A bit warm.
Entry trajectory looks right. | Entry trajectory looks right. | Entry path looks correct.
The shield is working. So are we. | The shield is working. So are we. | Shield works. We work too.

spanish: Ya estáis abajo del todo. Casi.
english: You're almost all the way down. Almost. | You're almost all the way down. Almost. | Nearly down. Nearly.
Speed coming down. Very good. | Speed coming down. Very good. | Slowing down. Good.

spanish: Control, ya veo el suelo. Qué bonito es.
english: Control, I can see the ground. It's so pretty. | Control, I can see the ground. It's so pretty. | Control, the ground is in view. So pretty.
You'll be standing on it soon. Easy. | You'll be standing on it soon. Easy. | You'll stand on it soon. Easy now.

spanish: Todo listo para bajar. Manos quietas.
english: All set for the way down. Hands still. | All set for the way down. Hands still. | Ready for the descent. Steady hands.

spanish: Bajando suave. Como una pluma gorda.
english: Coming down softly. Like a fat feather. | Coming down softly. Like a fat feather. | Floating down. A chubby feather.
Control, is anyone waiting down there? | Control, is anyone waiting down there? | Control, anyone waiting for us?

spanish: Todo el centro espacial. Con tarta.
english: The whole space center. With cake. | The whole space center. With cake. | Everyone. With cake.
Stable descent. Almost home. | Stable descent. Almost home. | Steady descent. Nearly home.
Altitude dropping. Nerves rising. | Altitude dropping. Nerves rising. | Lower altitude. Higher nerves.

spanish: Lo hacéis muy bien. Ya queda poco.
english: You're doing very well. Not long now. | You're doing very well. Not long now. | Very well done. Almost there.
